tools.name: check_document
tools.description:
Cheap cache-check: has this exact document already been inspected? Hash the file
    yourself (sha256, lowercase hex) and call this before verify_document to skip a redundant
    (paid) inspection. Returns {cached, warrant_id, permalink}.

tools.name: get_warrant
tools.description:
Retrieve a stored warrant by id (e.g. 'warrant_<hex>') — the full bundle as JSON, or a
    human-readable Markdown report when as_markdown=True.

    USE THIS WHEN you have a warrant_id from an earlier verify_document / check_document call
    and need the FULL evidence — every signal that fired, pe

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description:
Record thumbs up/down on a warrant's rating (the engine's precision-flywheel label
    source). verdict must be 'up' or 'down'; note is optional free text.

    USE THIS WHEN the ground truth became known after a verify_document call — e.g. the
    document was later confirmed genuine or fraudulent

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_fields, verify_identity, check_pack, screen_adverse_media, detect_ai_text, verify_references, check_source_overlap, find_tenders, tender_sources · Private data: verify_document, check_document, submit_feedback, extract_fields, verify_identity, check_pack, screen_adverse_media, detect_ai_text, verify_references, check_source_overlap, match_tenders · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: verify_identity, check_pack, tender_sources.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_fields, verify_identity, check_pack, screen_adverse_media, detect_ai_text, verify_references, check_source_overlap, find_tenders, tender_sources · Private data: verify_document, check_document, submit_feedback, extract_fields, verify_identity, check_pack, screen_adverse_media, detect_ai_text, verify_references, check_source_overlap, match_tenders · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: verify_identity, check_pack, tender_sources

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "verify_document" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
